definitions.gloss: economic boom; prosperity; good economic conditions
definitions.explanation: A period of strong economic activity characterized by growth, rising employment, and increased consumer spending. The opposite of {不景気|ふけいき} (recession).

examples.japanese: {好景気|こうけいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{好景気|こうけいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧しやすく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the economic boom, it became easier to find a job.

examples.japanese: ⟦バブル→バブル：11120_baburu⟧{期|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好景気|こうけいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The economic boom of the bubble era had a major impact on Japan's economy.

notes:
A compound of {好|こう} (good, favorable) and ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧ (economic conditions). Refers to a period when the economy is performing well. Often discussed in relation to specific historical booms in Japan.

USAGE:
Used in news, economic commentary, and everyday conversation about economic conditions. Can function as a no-adjective with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns. Japan's postwar economic history includes several named booms, such as the {神武景気|じんむけいき} (Jimmu boom, 1954-57) and the bubble economy of the late 1980s.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好景気|こうけいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ — the boom continues
- {好景気|こうけいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧ — to be bustling with prosperity
- {好景気|こうけいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恩恵|おんけい}→恩恵：04115_onkei⟧ — the benefits of a boom
- ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好景気|こうけいき} — an unprecedented boom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧ — economic conditions (neutral)
- ⟦{不景気|ふけいき}→不景気：18557_fukeiki⟧ — recession, economic downturn (opposite)
- ⟦{繁栄|はんえい}→繁栄：10131_hanei⟧ — prosperity, flourishing (broader, not just economic)
